body:
@precup You beat me to it. :)
But unless you use the stripped prefix/extension for constructing the `path` variable on line 110, wouldn't you allow for cases like the following?
```
> var temp_file = FileAccess.create_temp(FileAccess.READ_WRITE, "     ", "     ")
> print(temp_file.get_path_absolute())
C:/Users/test/AppData/Local/Temp/     -2025042913413335579210.       
```
Is that supposed to be allowed?

> @precup You beat me to it. :) But unless you use the stripped prefix/extension for constructing the `path` variable on line 110, wouldn't you allow for cases like the following?
> ...
> Is that supposed to be allowed?

Fixed.

btw regarding FileAccess i wonder why some of the methods has `ModeFlags p_mode_flags` argument while the others are `int p_mode_flags`. In the [docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_fileaccess.html), `create_temp()` is the only one that has `p_mode_flags` argument as `int` while the others are `ModeFlags`. This might be out of the scope of this PR, but i'm just mentioning if any of you guys could do something about it.

> @precup You beat me to it. :) But unless you use the stripped prefix/extension for constructing the `path` variable on line 110, wouldn't you allow for cases like the following?
> 
> ```
> > var temp_file = FileAccess.create_temp(FileAccess.READ_WRITE, "     ", "     ")
> > print(temp_file.get_path_absolute())
> C:/Users/test/AppData/Local/Temp/     -2025042913413335579210.       
> ```
> 
> Is that supposed to be allowed?

~If the operating system let you create files like that, then my guess is yes.~  

Godot defines a valid filename as not starting or ending with spaces, so you are right.  
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_string.html#class-string-method-is-valid-filename  

-------

Also we could use `!p_prefix.is_empty()` instead of checking length `p_prefix.length() > 0`.

https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_string.html#class-string-method-is-valid-filename  
> A valid file name cannot be empty, begin or end with space characters...

Tested and it seems fine.  
Is weird having space after prefix and before extension but is a valid filename...  

<details>
<summary>Testing code</summary>

```gdscript
extends Control


func _ready() -> void:
	print("DirAccess.create_temp should be ✔️:")
	test_creating_dir("")
	test_creating_dir("f")
	test_creating_dir("foo")
	test_creating_dir("foo ")
	
	print("DirAccess.create_temp should be ❌:")
	test_creating_dir(" foo")
	test_creating_dir(" foo ")
	
	print("FileAccess.create_temp should be ✔️:")
	test_creating_file("", "")
	test_creating_file("f", "")
	test_creating_file("", "f")
	test_creating_file("f", "f")
	test_creating_file("foo", "")
	test_creating_file("", "bar")
	test_creating_file("foo", "bar")
	test_creating_file("foo ", "")
	test_creating_file("", " bar")
	test_creating_file("foo ", " bar")
	
	print("FileAccess.create_temp should be ❌:")
	test_creating_file(" foo", "")
	test_creating_file("", "bar ")
	test_creating_file(" foo", "bar ")
	test_creating_file(" foo ", "")
	test_creating_file("", " bar ")
	test_creating_file(" foo ", " bar ")


func test_creating_dir(prefix: String) -> void:
	var result := DirAccess.create_temp(prefix)
	
	if result:
		prints("✔️", "\"" + prefix + "\"", result.get_current_dir())
		DirAccess.remove_absolute(result.get_current_dir())
	else:
		prints("❌", "\"" + prefix + "\"")


func test_creating_file(prefix: String, extension: String) -> void:
	var result := FileAccess.create_temp(FileAccess.WRITE, prefix, extension)
	
	if result:
		prints("✔️", "\"" + prefix + "\"", "&", "\"" + extension + "\"", result.get_path_absolute())
		DirAccess.remove_absolute(result.get_path_absolute())
	else:
		prints("❌", "\"" + prefix + "\"", "&", "\"" + extension + "\"")
```

</details>
